title: Per-run sequence starts at zero
statement: Every run's first event uses EventSeq::new(0)

title: Strict append durability
statement: append_strict returns Ok only after SyncAll

title: Batch atomic commit
statement: OwnedWriteBatch commits atomically with single SyncAll

title: No duplicate event from batch retry
statement: Retry after failed batch commit uses same seq successfully

title: Validation precedes durable mutation
statement: Pre-flight checks complete before any durable write

title: Sequence overflow typed error
statement: u64::MAX increment returns SequenceOverflow before write

title: Cross-run sequence independence
statement: Multiple runs can each have event at seq 0

title: write_lock is poison-detection only
statement: write_lock does not serialize writers; poison detection only
